reviews.panel_interpretation: Third panel (edited reference) preferred over the middle trial panel, inferred from the displayed comparison and the user's explanation.
reviews.source: User review in this chat after the frozen trial comparison
reviews.user_explanation: A horizontal tape line close to the meniscus causes bleeding. The blue-green/yellow region included by the middle panel was judged contamination. In previous inspection, an earlier intake bottom appeared close to the top of the larger edited intake.
reviews.continuity_observation_status: The user recalled this from earlier inspection, not directly from the displayed narrow crop. Bin 70 is a candidate earlier anchor identified in the archived edits; it is not independently verified as the intended event.
reviews.criterion: Prefer a continuous physical meniscus trajectory anchored by trustworthy earlier levels and allowing evaporation, rather than including the whole apparent jump away from a contaminating line.
limitations: This is a post-evaluation development annotation, not an independent validation label.
The nearest previous positive bin can itself follow the contaminated raw trace.
Do not force exact alignment: evaporation, model drift and measurement uncertainty remain relevant.
